Package sysmlinjava.javaannotations.requirements

package sysmlinjava.javaannotations.requirements
Annotations used to declare field variables as an element or type of a SysML requirement. SysMLinJava uses the annotations on fields to recognize and identify the elements that comprise the SysMLinJava model.
